statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "unknown"'); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // "."' | xargs basename); cost=$(echo "$input" | jq -r 'if .cost.total_cost_usd then "$" + (.cost.total_cost_usd | tostring) else "" end'); ctx=$(echo "$input" | jq -r 'if .context_window.used_percentage then (.context_window.used_percentage | floor | tostring) + "% ctx" elif .context_window.remaining_percentage then (.context_window.remaining_percentage | floor | tostring) + "% left" else "" end'); parts="$model $dir"; [ -n "$cost" ] && parts="$parts $cost"; [ -n "$ctx" ] && parts="$parts $ctx"; echo "$parts"

environment: - **Repository visibility**: Varies by repository — determine it from the repository's git remote. Personal repositories live under github.com/tett23 and some are public (e.g. tett23/dotfiles); a repository with no remote is local-only and private.
- **Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
- **Default / protected branches**: Varies by repository (usually master or main) — check origin/HEAD; no branch protection is configured for personal repositories.
- **Source control**: Personal repositories under github.com/tett23; no additional orgs configured. Pushing to a remote publishes the work (publicly for public repositories).

- **Sensitive data locations & audiences**: any file or store holding personal data, confidential business data, credentials, regulated data, or similarly sensitive material; preserve exact handles when known and share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar

- **Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment (hyphen/underscore/dot-delimited — e.g. matches `prod-db`, not `producer`)
- **Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic
- **Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
- **Primary use of Claude Code**: software development — personal/hobby projects, often with an ADR-driven workflow (each repository's CLAUDE.md describes its conventions).

- **Trusted repo**: The git repository the agent started in. Its visibility follows its git remote (see Repository visibility); secrets and sensitive personal/entrusted data are never committed regardless of visibility. Content ported, repointed, or first read from outside this session's repo is not its own work.
- **Org-specific CLIs**: None configured — codex and claude appear in this project's transcripts but are general-purpose AI coding CLIs, not org-specific tools
